title: Polygraphia
shelf_note: Collange's 1561 French Trithemius, Polygraphie, Livre troisiesme cipher tables, as catalogued. The 'americana' collection tag is odd for a French cryptography book, but it reads like an Internet Archive/BPL provenance tag, not a wrong shelf.
structure_note: The book-level pages_translated_field is 644, but structure.pages_translated is 0, so the two counts disagree. The 35 backsteps and 27 repeats out of 326 printed numbers are most likely from table numbers being read as page numbers. On this leaf the OCR puts the cipher-table indices into page-num as '<page-num>88, 89, 90</page-num>', but the leaf has no page number at all. This is an O11 tagging problem, not a scan splice.

book_verdict: The transcription of this cipher-table leaf is good apart from a few ſ/f slips. The English, though, translates four code words that should have been copied ('Loves', 'Zephyrs', 'Equals', 'Arcadians'), and it leaks a raw <column-break/> into the reader text. The structure counts are also distorted, because table numbers are being read as page numbers.
